params.body:
## What

Two additions the Observatory's Sources screen needs (Trendwolves/gentells-dashboard, proposed right after this one):

- **`/collection` passes each adapter's `sources` patterns and `cadence`** (`packages/core/adapter-runs.mjs`, `standings()`). The screen puts every row in `sources` under the adapter that reads it, with the same three shapes `claims()` reads (`type:rss`, `tiktok-cc-*`, an exact id), and shows how long an adapter rests between runs.
- **The `sources` query carries `signals30d` per source** (`packages/server/query-endpoint.mjs`): signals ingested in the last 30 days, one `GROUP BY source_id` over the indexed column, with the same window `/mix` uses. The screen shows it on each source, so the feeds that carry the corpus and the ones that say nothing can be told apart.

## Why

The Sources screen held two lists that never met: an adapter table that said "rss: BBC Three: Status code 500", and further down every source as a card, its error on a tooltip. The redesign groups each source under its adapter and puts a broken feed first with its Mute next to it. Without the patterns the page can only guess by name. Without a count per source, there is nothing to say which of 33 feeds is worth keeping.

## Order

Merge this before the dashboard PR. It replaces #306, which went out empty and can be closed. Until it is live, the new screen shows no counts and puts every row under "read by no adapter".

## Tests

- New: `standings()` passes `sources` and `cadence`; `signals30d` counts two signals inside the window and not the one 40 days old.
- Full suite on the workbench: 1,089 of 1,095 pass. The six that fail are `report-render`, which needs `pdftoppm`; that binary is missing on the workbench, and they fail the same way on unchanged main.
params.title: Sources screen: which rows each adapter reads, and what each source brought in
